title: Oplax mate components are isomorphisms
statement: For a scheme X, a left adjoint P to global sections, and a chosen lax monoidal structure on global sections whose unit and tensor maps are the concrete section maps, the oplax monoidal structure transported to P by the adjunction has isomorphism unit and tensor components.

proof.text: Unfold the left-adjoint oplax structure and rewrite its unit and tensor components using the prescribed concrete unit and tensor maps; apply the isomorphism assertions for the corresponding adjunction mates.

proof_origin.by: D4 second reader; unfolding Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal

theorem globalTensorPullback_oplax_isIso
    (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace)
    (lax : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).LaxMonoidal)
    (hε : Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (unitSectionsEquiv (X := X) ⊤).toLinearMap)
    (hμ : ∀ M N, Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) M N =
      moduleCup_sectionTensorMap X M N) :
    IsIso (adj.leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal.η) ∧
      (∀ A B, IsIso (adj.leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal.δ A B))
